## 4. Funds Flow Memorandum — Framework

### 4A. Sources of Funds

| Source | Amount (USD) | Description | Wire Instructions Status |
|--------|-------------|-------------|-------------------------|
| Buyer Equity Contribution | $[●] | Equity rollover / cash equity | ⬜ Pending confirmation |

| Debt Financing – Revolver Draw (if any) | $[●] | Working capital facility | ⬜ Pending |
| **Total Sources** | **$[●]** | | |

### 4B. Uses of Funds

| Use | Amount (USD) | Payee | Account / Wire Details | Timing |
|-----|-------------|-------|------------------------|--------|
| Aggregate Merger Consideration (to Target stockholders) | $[●] | Paying Agent / Exchange Agent | TBD | At Closing |
| Payoff – Senior Secured Facility | $[●] | [Lender Name] | Per payoff letter | Simultaneously at Closing |
| Payoff – Other Indebtedness | $[●] | [Creditor Name] | Per payoff letter | Simultaneously at Closing |
| Transaction Expenses – Buyer | $[●] | Advisors per invoice | Per invoice wire instructions | At Closing or T+1 |
| Transaction Expenses – Target (per SPA) | $[●] | Target advisors | Per invoice wire instructions | At Closing |
| Indemnity Escrow Deposit | $[●] | [Escrow Agent] | Escrow Account per Escrow Agreement | At Closing |
| Purchase Price Adjustment Escrow | $[●] | [Escrow Agent] | Escrow Account per Escrow Agreement | At Closing |
| Rollover Equity (non-cash) | $[●] | Rollover Stockholders | New equity interests in Buyer/HoldCo | At Closing |
| **Total Uses** | **$[●]** | | | |

### 4C. Funds Flow Sequencing

```
T-2 Days:   Payoff letters finalized; wire instructions verified with each payee
T-1 Day:    Funds-flow memo circulated to all counsel; pre-funding confirmations
            W-9/W-8 forms collected for all payees
Closing AM: Pre-wire conference call — all parties confirm conditions satisfied
            Escrow Agreement countersigned
Closing:    Debt funding → Buyer's account  [Step 1]
            Equity contribution wired        [Step 2]
            Buyer wires purchase price to Paying Agent / Escrow [Step 3]
            Payoff wires released simultaneously [Step 4]
            Transaction expense wires released [Step 5]
            Escrow deposits funded          [Step 6]
            Transfer agent notified; stock cancellation / issuance [Step 7]
T+1 Day:    Wire confirmations archived; closing confirmed in writing
```
